item.title: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds launched at Moscow
item.description: Moscow's mayor described the wave of drones as the "largest ever" attack on the Russian capital and said there had been damage to a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building.

item.title: Thousands of planned launches, terms of deal, worry some near Louisiana SpaceX site
item.description: State officials say the new SpaceX site will be a $100 billion investment and launch thousands of rockets. Lawmakers helped ease regulations and negotiations were covered under nondisclosure agreements.

item.title: NPR's College Podcast Challenge is back for 2026
item.description: Students: It's time to turn on the mic and hit 'record.' Send us your podcasts and we'll pick the best ones. It's $5,000 for our grand prize and $500 for our finalists.

item.title: Saudi Arabia says Houthis tried to attack its capital
item.description: Saudi Arabia on Saturday said that Yemen's Houthi rebels tried to attack Riyadh with a ballistic missile, the first time the Saudi capital has been targeted since the escalation in fighting with the Iran-backed rebels opened a new front in the Iran war.

item.title: Ed Sheeran says situation in Gaza is 'catastrophic and unjustifiable' as he opens solo concert
item.description: Ed Sheeran opened a solo concert Saturday with comments about Gaza after controversy swirled around his tour and supporting acts withdrew in solidarity with opener Macklemore, who was dropped after making pro-Palestinian comments onstage.

item.title: The new lines of southern Lebanon
item.description: The U.N. expanded the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon's mandate 20 years ago to include monitoring adherence to a ceasefire in fighting between Israel and Lebanon's Iran-backed Hezbollah — the militant group created in 1982 to counter a second Israeli invasion.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico reporters denied access to White House following Trump ban
item.description: Three reporters were blocked from the White House grounds Saturday morning, a day after President Trump said CNN, Politico, and MS NOW would be banned for reporting "FICTION and LIES."

item.title: Betel nuts are a top mind-affecting substance. Now there's evidence of ancient use
item.description: New research on ancient human remains suggests the habitual usage of betel nuts, a plant seed with mind-affecting properties that is popular in parts of Asia despite the health risks it presents.
